Shanghai welcomes tennis players and fans.

Shanghai is welcoming leading tennis players for the Shanghai Masters. The main matches begin on Wednesday at the Qizhong Tennis Center. Players from China and other countries are taking part. Four Chinese players received special invitations to join the main competition.

For local players, a big event at home offers a chance to play against strong opponents. Chinese player Wu Yibing says these events help younger players develop. He also remembers the support he received from fans during an earlier match in Shanghai.

Fans have activities to enjoy away from the main matches too. A four-day tennis carnival earlier this month let visitors watch practice, explore exhibitions and join competitions. A special pet-friendly area has also returned to the tennis center. The tournament is due to finish on October eighteenth.
